Open questions in REQUIREMENTS.md
(pi 1.0 lane, 2026-10-04) mcp.json's own shape failures (not JSON, not an object, mcpServers not an object) are exercised by three uncited checks in packages/nana-setup/tests/doctor-detail.test.mjs but have no row. Add an R-366-shaped row, or declare them R-365's error handling.
(writing trial, astra r3, 2026-10-04) R-753/R-755's cap is a CHARACTER budget on the injected block, while the read ceiling (R-755) is a BYTE budget on the file. A valid multi-byte-heavy rule (e.g. a 2,000-character Chinese file) can be cut well short of 4,000 characters while the notice still reads "cut at 4000 chars" — the notice is imprecise in that direction. Document the distinction; the byte/character gap is accepted, not fixed, for the trial.
1. The pack's README is 721 lines of declared behaviour and produced 258 rows; the extraction notes name a safe trim (merge same-status rows inside the gate, handoff and pi-review sections). Trim, or keep the grain?
6b. Clause-level honesty. The form half closed 2026-10-04 (docs/reviews/ears-form-2026-10-04/lane-close-ruling.md); the coverage half is this question. Origin: sol r3 2026-10-02 showed the rail proves marker identity and citation existence, not clause coverage; a 25-row sample pinned fully in 16 (64%). The EARS-form lane then split every multi-shall row: 200 origins into 244 new rows, 0 off form, G-013 implemented. EARS_ALLOWANCE sits at 0, sealed and held equal to the measured count (R-757). The lane judged the rows it touched under a standard that tightened as it ran. A3 and B's implemented rows (10 and 10 split-born, 9 and 7 origins) carry one recorded red mutation per named condition. In those, astra read every record and replayed one in five (bc-method-ruling.md). A1 and A2's (32 and 30 split-born, 33 and 28 origins) carry one red mutation per row, sampled 20 per batch at 19 of 20. C's 44 origins and the 289 implemented rows never off form carry their pre-lane cites, unjudged. Under t

===== phone 390px · view #issues =====
Nana pi product ledger

Commit: 9097580db7e78129fe0da86e41cd1a203b1f97ee · 2026-10-28T21:26:51-04:00 · Working tree: clean

Overview
Decisions
Product
Artifacts
Features
Issues
Requirements
Issues

Each file's label is reported once, not per cited test — a run covering a file can hide a skipped check inside it. copies run from a temporary folder and children stopped by a signal are not counted. No recorded run anywhere in this report: no runtime data.

R-433
violated

The desk shall bound the per-child status, widget and unanswered-dialog maps a child fills through its own events.

unbounded for the life of the session in handleChildEvent, apps/desk/server.mjs, and replayed whole in every hello; declared in README Known limits and STILL OPEN in docs/review-punchlist-2026-09-08.md

Tests: none cited in this repository

R-435
violated

A picker whose RPC is already in flight when the session is switched shall not act on the newly selected session.

declared open in README Known limits and in the punchlist race section; closing the popover narrows but does not close the window

Tests: none cited in this repository

R-436
violated

A steer whose text is byte-identical to a still-pending prompt shall not consume that prompt's optimistic bubble.

declared in README Known limits; the echo match is by content, so one bubble serves two messages until a resync repairs it

Tests: none cited in this repository

R-445
violated

Two desks writing one session's record shall each keep what the other added.

no cross-process lock by design, so simultaneous writers keep only the last writer's additions and the store holds no copy of what was lost; declared in README Known limits and the punchlist open sub-items

Tests: none cited in this repository

R-446
violated

The stage-key store shall not block the desk's event loop while it reads or writes.

its per-session reads and writes and the one-time enumeration are synchronous on the event loop, so a hung filesystem stalls the whole process; declared in README Known limits

Tests: none cited in this repository

Implemented rows that did not pass in this clone's last measured run: 0

A row appears here when a cited file's last recorded run failed, or when every cited file's last recorded run skipped or failed. A file with no recorded run counts neither way.

violated

unbounded for the life of the session in handleChildEvent, apps/desk/server.mjs, and replayed whole in every hello; declared in README Known limits and STILL OPEN in docs/review-punchlist-2026-09-08.md

R-435
violated

A picker whose RPC is already in flight when the session is switched shall not act on the newly selected session.

declared open in README Known limits and in the punchlist race section; closing the popover narrows but does not close the window

R-436
violated

A steer whose text is byte-identical to a still-pending prompt shall not consume that prompt's optimistic bubble.

declared in README Known limits; the echo match is by content, so one bubble serves two messages until a resync repairs it

Tests: none cited in this repository

R-445
violated

Two desks writing one session's record shall each keep what the other added.

no cross-process lock by design, so simultaneous writers keep only the last writer's additions and the store holds no copy of what was lost; declared in README Known limits and the punchlist open sub-items

Tests: none cited in this repository

R-446
violated

The stage-key store shall not block the desk's event loop while it reads or writes.

its per-session reads and writes and the one-time enumeration are synchronous on the event loop, so a hung filesystem stalls the whole process; declared in README Known limits
